name: Screen showcase
oneLiner: a screen recording or screenshot floats in a window on a brand-colour gradient with a soft shadow and slow 3D drift, a facecam tile sits in a corner, then a focus box snaps onto one region with a quick push-in and 1 to 3 callout pins draw leader lines to tag pills
say: when the speaker shows the product or a result on screen and points at one part ('look at this summary here'): cut in on 'look', the focus box snaps on the word that names the part, the pills land on the features they list. Swap screen for any screenshot or a still from the recording. 9:16 also takes layout top (window in the upper ~45%, speaker below, no facecam)
